about: sequence level 4: a 2-block pre-norm transformer (width 32, 4 heads, MLP 128, ReLU, learned positions, context 12) that reverses 6 digits written after a separator (token 10). Trained by docs/reports/sequence-L4-numbers.py --write: seed 0, Adam 0.003 with 50 warm-up steps and cosine decay, 400 steps of 64 fresh sequences, none from the 1,000 held out by default_rng(1). Arrays are little-endian float32 in base64; read with seq_ops_l4.read_model. Generated for this course; no third-party data.
